a_before_b.rationale: Adapter-based finetuning is a parameter-efficient technique that can be applied independently of preference alignment; understanding preference finetuning is not required to grasp how adapters work or their trade-offs.

b_before_a.rationale: Preference finetuning is a post-training alignment step whose definition does not depend on knowing adapter-based finetuning, as it can be implemented through full-model or other parameter-efficient methods.
